New platform helps marketing and product teams compare competitors, identify patterns and understand change over time

OTTAWA, ON – TheNewswire - September 9, 2026 — FUNDbeat Inc. today announced the launch of FUNDbeat, a new competitive intelligence platform designed specifically to help fund companies understand and compare competitors across a selected peer group.

Fund companies publish a steady stream of publicly available content such as press releases, articles, videos, webinars and podcasts. Turning that volume of information into meaningful comparisons across competitors and over time can require significant research and analysis.

FUNDbeat continuously monitors this activity and applies a consistent, industry-specific classification framework. The resulting structured dataset allows fund companies to compare firms, identify patterns and understand how the competitive landscape is evolving over time.

“There has never been a shortage of competitive information in the fund industry,” said Jonathan Georges, CIM®, FCSI®, Founder of FUNDbeat Inc. “The challenge is making that information comparable. FUNDbeat applies a consistent structure across companies and over time so firms can move beyond tracking individual competitor activity and start identifying the patterns within it.”
FUNDbeat's historical dataset extends back to January 1, 2022, allowing users to examine how competitor communications, themes and product activity have evolved over several years.

The platform identifies which subjects competitors are emphasizing in their content, their relative Share of Voice and how those patterns are changing. Voice Differentiation uses semantic analysis to compare the underlying meaning of communications from firms discussing the same subject, revealing how distinctive each firm's messaging is relative to its peers.

FUNDbeat brings visibility and differentiation together in its Positioning Matrix, showing how prominently a firm participates in a competitive conversation alongside how distinctive its messaging is relative to peers.

“It's relatively easy to see which fund companies are most active on a subject. What's much harder to understand is whether they're actually saying something different,” Georges said. “Looking at those two dimensions together provides a very different perspective on the competitive landscape.”

Beyond competitor communications, FUNDbeat tracks product activity such as fund launches, mergers and terminations, while company-level intelligence brings together different analytical perspectives on individual firms.

Artificial intelligence is used to classify and analyze large volumes of unstructured fund-company content against FUNDbeat's industry-specific framework, while the underlying information is maintained as a structured historical dataset for consistent comparison across firms and over time.
The platform is designed for marketing, product and distribution leaders who want to spend less time assembling competitive information and more time interpreting what it means for their business.
FUNDbeat was founded by Georges following over 30 years of experience across the investment and financial-technology industries.
About FUNDbeat

FUNDbeat is a competitive intelligence platform built specifically for fund companies. It monitors publicly available fund-company activity, structures it using a consistent industry-specific framework, and provides analytics that help firms understand where competitors are focusing, how they compare and what is changing across their selected peer group.
